info.name: IMPS API Collection (Dynamic)
info.description: IMPS API Collection. Ports: IMPS 8443, Switch 8444, NPCI 8445 (from .env). Default profile prod,ssl. Dynamic URL: https://{{host}}:{{port}}/imps/{{reqtype|resptype}}/{{txnId}}. Set host, impsPort, switchPort, npciPort in variables. API path: /imps/reqpay|reqchktxn|reqhbt|reqlistaccpvd|reqvaladd/{{txnId}}. See samples/README.txt for ISO/XML samples.

variable.description: Host IP. Change this and ports below; all request URLs update dynamically.
Set by prerequest from host + impsPort. Format: https://{{host}}:{{impsPort}}.
Message ID (Head @msgId): 35 chars. Fetched from NPCI Mock GET /api/ids or set in pre-request.
IMPS REST over HTTPS (port 8443). Use mvn spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=ssl. Disable SSL cert verification in Postman for dev.
NPCI Mock HTTPS when run with ssl profile (port 8445).
Sample ISO 8583 0200 (ReqPay) base64 for Switch → IMPS body.
Sample ISO 8583 0200 (ReqChkTxn) base64 for Switch → IMPS body.
Sample ISO 8583 0800 (ReqHbt) base64 for Switch → IMPS body.
Sample ISO 8583 0200 (ReqListAccPvd) base64 for Switch → IMPS body.
Sample ISO 8583 0200 (ReqValAdd) base64 for Switch → IMPS body.

exec: // txnId / msgId: exactly 35 chars = BPC (3) + Unique ID (32). BPC assigned by NPCI; Unique ID = UUID/random/system-generated.
var bpc = 'BAN';  // Bank Participation Code, 3 chars (replace with NPCI-assigned BPC if different)
for (var i = 0; i < 32; i++) s += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
// Dynamic base URLs from host + port (change host/impsPort/switchPort/npciPort only)

item.name: NPCI - IMPS req flow
item.description: NPCI sends requests to IMPS. Dynamic path: /imps/{reqpay|reqchktxn|reqvaladd|reqhbt|reqlistaccpvd}/{txn_id}. Use unique txnId per request (duplicate returns 409). Rule 021: Head @msgId must be 35 chars (3 BPC + 32). Rule 022: Txn @id must be 35 chars. Head @msgId is required for ACK.
